# MRaiders AI coding guidance
Read AGENTS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md first. Native C++20/Qt6/CMake is the forward path.
Keep Electron in place as legacy reference until the native release passes functional verification.
Implement offline, manual, user-directed functionality only; no live gameplay analysis, memory reading,
packet interception, injection, stealth/detection-evasion features, or gameplay input automation.
Never claim unverified marker data is authoritative. Use small, tested PRs and report actual evidence.
